name: anath-strip
description: The Anath AI buttons above the typing box: Menu, My day, To-do, Email and Winning ads, and on a second line What's new, Memories and Planner, plus the morning day bar and the check-in bar. In a student's My brain each one shows once its lesson is done; in a client's folder they're all on. Taps on your pages beside the chat go straight into the chat.
